title: Agent Skills Well-Known Index (v1)
description: Manifest published at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json so that external agents can discover and load skills via the well-known URL convention. The shape MUST match the IndexSchema / IndexSkill types in scripts/generate-well-known.ts (the authoritative generator). Each `skills[]` entry exposes a `files[]` array listing every file shipped with the skill (relative POSIX paths; `SKILL.md` first) so that loaders can prefetch the full skill bundle instead of only the SKILL.md pointed to by `sourceUrl`.

$schema.description: Absolute URL of this schema document. MUST match the value of `$id`.

skills.description: Ordered list of skills exposed by this index. Order is not significant for discovery but should be stable for deterministic output.

name.description: hyphen-case skill name. MUST match the directory name and the SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

description.description: Third-person skill description. Recommended starting phrase: `Use this skill when …`. Maximum 1024 characters.

sourceUrl.description: Absolute URL of the skill's SKILL.md file, resolvable by external agents without further base URL knowledge. Format: `${endpointUrl}/skills/<category>/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`.

installName.description: Install identifier in `<owner>/<repo>@<skill-name>` form (using `@` separator, aligned with source-parser protocol).

skillPath.description: Full POSIX subpath of the source skill (`/` separator, includes the skillName). Aligned with the `/skills/...` segment of `sourceUrl` (decision 0048). Format: `skills/<category>/<skill-name>`. `<category>` is intentionally NOT restricted to a hard-coded whitelist so future categories can be added without schema changes; current repo uses `builtin` / `tools` / `dev` (see AGENTS.md §3). The store materializes the skill as `cacheDir/<pluginSlug>/<skillPath>/`, mirroring the layout after `git clone`.

files.description: List of files shipped with the skill, as POSIX-relative paths from the skill directory. `files[0]` is always `SKILL.md`; remaining entries are obtained by recursively scanning `references/`, `scripts/`, `assets/` and any other subdirectories in lexicographic order (macOS/Windows noise files `.DS_Store` / `Thumbs.db` and hidden directories are skipped). Agent loaders can prefetch the entire skill bundle from this field instead of only fetching the SKILL.md pointed to by `sourceUrl`. Each path is relative to the skill directory and uses POSIX separators; absolute URLs are reconstructed by combining `sourceUrl` + `skillPath` and MUST NOT appear here. File-name segments MAY contain `[` and `]` (OOXML templates such as `[Content_Types].xml` are legitimate files) but MUST NOT start with `/` and MUST NOT contain `..`.

items.description: POSIX-relative path from the skill directory. MUST NOT start with `/`; MUST NOT contain `..`. File-name segments MAY contain `[]` for OOXML compatibility.

scope.description: Optional context scope, aligned with SkillMetadataSchema.scope. Defaults to `all` when the SKILL.md frontmatter does not declare it. One of: `general` / `coder` / `all`.
